evidence.description: Under Construction ## About Adani Link Bay Adani Linkbay Residences is a luxury residential development by Adani Realty situated along New Link Road in Andheri West, Mumbai. Spread across 2.5 acres, the project comprises six towers of G+26 floors, offering apartments in 2, 2.5, 3, and 4 BHK configurations. With over 50 lifestyle amenities — including a rooftop infinity pool, sky lounge, and sports arena — it targets discerning urban homebuyers who want a well-connected Mumbai address with premium facilities. The project is MahaRERA registered under number P51800047539, and a second phase (Wing B) has also been launched under MahaRERA. ## Key Highlights [...] 2.5-acre integrated development with six G+26 towers — compact land parcel but vertical density maximised 50+ lifestyle amenities including a rooftop infinity pool, sky lounge, and a dedicated sports arena MahaRERA registered under P51800047539 — legal compliance verified, buyers can track construction on MahaRERA portal Three and four BHK apartments starting at ₹4.99 Cr — positioned as aspirational luxury on New Link Road Average price of ₹42,800/sq.ft. as of Q4 2025, up 6.07% from ₹40,350/sq.ft. in the same quarter last year Address: 111D, New Link Road, Kasam Nagar, Andheri West — directly on a major arterial road connecting Andheri to Malad Under construction status with Phase II Wing B also launched — buyers should track RERA portal for completion updates [...] ## Construction Progress Adani Linkbay Residences is registered under MahaRERA number P51800047539. The project is currently under construction across multiple towers. Phase II Wing B has also been launched with its own MahaRERA registration. Buyers can track tower-wise floor progress and completion timelines directly on the MahaRERA portal at maharera.mahaonline.gov.in — this is the most reliable source for construction updates, quarterly reports, and any amendments. As of available data, possession timelines are not publicly confirmed by the developer; buyers should verify directly with Adani Realty's sales team and cross-check on MahaRERA. ## Investment Analysis
